title: Five of the eleven internal-market purpose hints read differently from DR1 — one has a grammatical error, one uses "e.g." where DR1 spells out "for example", and three lose their closing full stop.

finding.frontend: The eleven options and their order match DR1 exactly, but five hints differ, all of them in src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/import-purpose/copy/copy.en.js:5-19. Transfer of ownership - Sale/gift reads "has as it's aim, the sale of" and ends "(e.g. a gift)" with no full stop; Breeding ends "or produce offspring" with no full stop; Racing, competition, show or training ends "competitive or training events" with no full stop; Production ends "any other animal product or by-product" with no full stop. The other six hints are identical to DR1.
finding.prototype: The same five hints read "has as its aim the sale of" and end "(for example a gift).", "or produce offspring.", "competitive or training events." and "any other animal product or by-product." DR1 uses the possessive "its" with no comma after it, writes "for example" out in full, and closes every one of the eleven hints with a full stop.
finding.difference: Replace the five hint strings with DR1's wording. One file, no template or logic change, and it can be done independently of everything else in this slice. "it's" for "its" is a plain error and "e.g." is against GOV.UK style, so this is worth doing whether or not the page-shape change lands.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding "as its aim" or "(for example a gift)" in the rendered frontend purpose page — the captured DOM at fe-import-purpose shows "as it's aim, the sale of" and "(e.g. a gift)".
